verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a programmatic Airbyte API, access tokens, and a Terraform provider. Nothing in the pack shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy. A community remark about a white-label platform being deprecated is an anecdote, not a published policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
